definitions.explanation: The outer edge or border of something, especially a round or hollow object: the rim of a cup, the brim of a hat, the frame of glasses, the edge of a pond or cliff.

examples.japanese: ⟦コップ→コップ：00862_koppu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|ふち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}けた→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: The rim of the glass chipped.

examples.japanese: ⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|ふち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧にした。
examples.english: I chose black frames for my glasses.
I sat on the edge of the pond and put my feet in the water.

notes:
Used for physical edges, especially rims of round things. In figurative use, ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|ふち} or ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}→絶望：04863_zetsubou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|ふち} (the brink of death, of despair) also occur, though ⟦{淵|ふち}→淵：13456_fuchi⟧ (a deep pool, an abyss) is the more usual writing there.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦コップ→コップ：00862_koppu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|ふち}: the rim of a glass
- ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|ふち}: the brim of a hat
- ⟦{縁|ふち}{取|ど}り→縁取る：32048_fuchidoru⟧: edging, a border
- {縁|ふち}なし⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧: rimless glasses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縁|へり}→縁：28477_heri⟧: edge, hem — the border strip of cloth, mats or paper
- ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧: same kanji, read えん: fate, connection between people
- ⟦{端|はし}→端：00936_hashi⟧: end, edge — the end point of something long
